result:
The audit's `store` and `update` findings are fixed, along with a related `PostRevision` finding it raised. `bun run typecheck` passes, and a scratch end-to-end check of create, edit, restore, and delete passed before I removed it.

- **`PostController.store`** now calls `Post.create(data, { set: { authorId: author.id } })` instead of spreading the request into `forceCreate`. `authorId` stays out of `fillable`.
- **`PostController.update`** no longer uses a force write. The revision snapshot is `PostRevision.create` with `set: { postId }`, inside the same transaction as the update.
- **`PostRevision`** (`app/Models/PostRevision.ts`) now has `fillable: ['title', 'excerpt', 'body']`, so `postId` can only come from the server.

The audit now reports 28 passed, with no API3 findings. Its one remaining failure is a high-severity advisory on `source-map-js`, plus a low-severity `katex` warning. Both come from dependencies I didn't change. Fixing them means upgrading packages or recording an ignore in `config/audit.ts`, so tell me which you want. Nothing is committed.
